templates.name: AMC Accordion Rail
templates.description: Side navigation drawn as a rail: every entry is a node on one line, groups open like an accordion with a smooth height morph, and the path from the current parent down to the current page glows along the rail.
templates.useFor: Navigation lists with one level of sub entries in a Left Column or side region: Orders with Open, Backorders and Returns, Invoices with Drafts and Overdue, Admin with Users and Settings.

templates.name: AMC Arrange Board
templates.description: Experimental: plain regions become a personal dashboard; every user can reorder, resize and collapse the regions that share one parent with keyboard-friendly header buttons, and the layout is remembered per page, with no dashboard plug-in and no server-side personalisation tables.
templates.useFor: Home pages and dashboards built from ordinary regions: Charts, Cards, Classic and Interactive Reports, Static Content and small Forms that users want in their own order and size.

templates.name: AMC Aurora Header
templates.description: A region with a tall header band of slowly drifting aurora light and film grain, carrying a large title and icon, and a calm content sheet that overlaps the band.
templates.useFor: Landing regions of a page or dashboard: a Cards region of KPIs, a Chart, a Classic Report of today's work or a Static Content welcome. Use one per page; it is a headline, not a panel for every region.

templates.name: AMC Auth Card
templates.description: A motion-rich authentication card for login, sign-up, forgot-password, OTP and reset pages: seven looks, seven full-screen scenes drawn behind the page, and opt-in field behaviour by item CSS class, while items, validations and processes stay native.
templates.useFor: The Static Content region that holds the page items and buttons of an authentication page: the app's Login page, Create account, Forgot password, OTP verification and Reset password.

templates.name: AMC Auth Result
templates.description: An outcome screen for authentication and other flows whose inline SVG symbol draws itself inside a glowing orbit ring, a checkmark in a filling ring, a paper plane landing on an envelope, a shield, a door, a draining hourglass, a shaking cross or a latching lock, over optional full-page aurora, meteor, grid, mesh, retro or particle scenes, with an optional countdown redirect.
templates.useFor: A Static Content region on a confirmation page or after a branch from a process: Account created, Password changed, Reset link sent, Email verified, Signed out, Link expired, Something went wrong, Access denied. Region title is the heading, region text is the message with native links, Next or Create is the primary action and Previous or Close the secondary one.

templates.name: AMC Beam Frame
templates.description: A region frame with a beam of light that travels around its border and speeds up while the region has hover or focus.
templates.useFor: Any region that deserves attention: a key Classic Report, an approval Form, a Chart, a KPI row or a Static Content summary.

templates.name: AMC Bento Launchpad
templates.description: A bento launchpad: list entries become tiles of mixed sizes with an oversized tilted icon, a description and a live metric, and the grid and every tile recompose with container queries as the region changes width.
templates.useFor: Home pages and workspace launchpads with 4 to 12 entries, where each destination has a short description and a number worth showing (open orders, overdue invoices, pending approvals).

templates.name: AMC Browser Window
templates.description: A browser-window mockup with real depth: a tab strip whose active tab carries the title and icon as favicon, a toolbar with an address pill, and a layered window shadow, with phone and tablet device frames for previewing pages.
templates.useFor: Previews and showcases: a Static Content or Cards region that previews a customer portal page, a release-notes region, a Form that edits what a public page shows, or a Chart embedded as a page mockup. Phone and tablet frames suit responsive previews.

templates.name: AMC Brutal Block
templates.description: A neo-brutalist region: thick ink border, hard offset shadow, a flat striped palette band and the title in a tilted sticker label that breaks out of the top edge.
templates.useFor: Regions that should shout on internal tools and admin pages: a work queue Classic Report, a checklist Form, a Chart on a status board or a Static Content notice.

templates.name: AMC Brutal Links
templates.description: Neo-brutalist link cards with ink borders, hard offset shadows, flat palette fills that rotate per entry, an oversized arrow and a press-down click.
templates.useFor: Launchpads and quick links on home pages and landing dashboards: module shortcuts, report hubs, self-service portals, onboarding steps.

templates.name: AMC Clay Menu
templates.description: A claymorphism pill menu on a soft tray: pillowy pills with glossy icon bubbles, soft inner and outer shadows, and the current entry pressed into the tray.
templates.useFor: Page-level menus and filters with 3 to 10 entries: module sub-navigation, report views, status filters, a toolbar of quick actions above a report.

templates.name: AMC Clay Panel
templates.description: A claymorphism region: a pillowy, softly lit panel with the title in a raised clay pill, the icon in a glossy clay bubble and the native content in a gently pressed tray.
templates.useFor: Friendly, consumer-style pages: a self-service portal Form, a Cards or KPI region, a Chart on a personal dashboard, or a short Classic Report.

templates.name: AMC Collapsible Morph
templates.description: A collapsible region whose card morphs into a compact pill when collapsed: width, corners and header shape change together while the body folds away, instead of a classic chevron header with a sliding body.
templates.useFor: Secondary or optional content that users open on demand: search filters above an Interactive Report, an advanced section of a Form, a Chart or a notes region on a dashboard.

templates.name: AMC Command List
templates.description: A command-palette list: a search box filters the entries as you type and highlights the match, arrow keys move between commands, and each row shows an icon, a description and its keyboard-shortcut chip.
templates.useFor: Action menus and power-user navigation: a Quick actions region on a dashboard, a task list on a record page, an admin or settings index with many entries.

templates.name: AMC Command Rail
templates.description: Side navigation that learns and searches: a Ctrl K search box filters every page and sub page, a star pins pages to the top, recent pages are learned by frecency, groups open smoothly with a glowing line from the current group down to the current page, and it folds into an icon rail with flyouts or a phone bottom sheet.
templates.useFor: The application Navigation Menu, side navigation, in User Interface > Navigation Menu, with one level of sub entries: Dashboard; Sales with Quotes, Orders and Customers; Finance with Invoices, Payments and Month-end close; Administration with Users and Settings. It also works in a List region in a Left Column.

templates.name: AMC Constellation Map
templates.description: A spatial map of the whole app: every list entry is a star, entries with the same group form a constellation joined by lines, the current page glows and, optionally, the pages you use most shine brighter, on a sky you can pan and zoom. The layout is stable across visits, so people remember where things are instead of reading menus.
templates.useFor: Home pages, app maps and 'all pages' launchers for lists of 6 to 40 entries in 2 to 8 groups: Sales with Orders, Quotes and Customers; Finance with Invoices, Payments and Month-end; Operations; Admin.

templates.name: AMC Dock Bar
templates.description: A desktop-style dock: glossy icon tiles stand on a 3D glass shelf with reflections, magnify with their neighbours under the pointer or keyboard focus, and show their label as a tooltip.
templates.useFor: Short launch lists of 4 to 10 entries: app switchers, module shortcuts on a home page, a floating quick-launch bar with the Float at page bottom option.

templates.name: AMC Dual View
templates.description: A region frame that turns the report it wraps into a chart of the same rows: a Table / Chart switch in the header draws a to-scale SVG bar chart or donut from the table itself, with no chart region, query or configuration, and keeps the table as the accessible source.
templates.useFor: Classic Report and Interactive Report regions with one text column to label the rows and one numeric column to compare: sales by region, orders by customer, spend by category, monthly totals. Around a Form, Chart or Static Content without a table it is a plain frame.

templates.name: AMC Flip Tiles
templates.description: Launch tiles that turn over in 3D on hover and keyboard focus: icon and label on the front, a description and a call to action on a colored back face, while each tile stays one real link.
templates.useFor: Launchpads and module menus with 3 to 16 entries where a destination needs one or two lines of explanation, such as self-service portals and onboarding hubs.

templates.name: AMC Focus Stage
templates.description: A region that can take the stage: its Focus button (or focusing a field inside it) dims and blurs the rest of the page behind a scrim and lifts the region with a sticky header, so a long form or a dense report gets the user's full attention without leaving the page.
templates.useFor: Long Forms (data entry, approvals, checklists), dense Interactive Reports or Interactive Grids, a Chart under discussion in a meeting, and any region that users work in for a long time on a busy page.

templates.name: AMC Folder Tab
templates.description: The region is a physical file folder: a trapezoid tab with the icon and title rises from the top edge, and the content sits on a sheet of grained paper tucked into a manila or palette-colored folder, optionally with more sheets peeking out behind it.
templates.useFor: Record-centred regions that read like a file: a customer or supplier Form, a contract or case summary in Static Content, the lines of an order in a Classic Report or Interactive Report, or a small Chart in a dossier page.

templates.name: AMC Frecency Launcher
templates.description: A launcher that learns: it counts which destinations this user opens and how recently, and at the next page load lifts the top three into ranked Your most used tiles with a heat meter and the last time they were opened, while the rest keep the developer's order in a compact grid.
templates.useFor: Home pages and workspace launchpads with 6 to 20 destinations, where different users live in different corners of the app: finance opens Invoices and Month-end close, sales opens Orders and Customers.

templates.name: AMC Freshness Frame
templates.description: A region frame that knows how old its data is: the header says Updated just now or 3 min ago, a fuse along the top edge burns down and loses its glow as the data ages, and past a threshold the frame turns to a hatched warning Out of date state with a Refresh button, which no design system frame does.
templates.useFor: Regions whose data changes while the page stays open: operational Classic and Interactive Reports, queues, dashboards, stock levels, Charts and Cards on wall screens, and reports loaded by a scheduled job.

templates.name: AMC Glass Depth
templates.description: A frosted-glass panel with a light top edge and layered depth shadow floats over soft colored light drawn on the region frame, with a second glass sheet peeking out beneath it, while the body sits on a calm readable sheet.
templates.useFor: Hero or summary regions on dashboards and home pages: a KPI Cards region, a Chart, a short Classic Report or a Form that should feel lifted off the page.

templates.name: AMC Holo Edge
templates.description: A holographic foil edge and header strip built from the theme palette, with a sheen that shifts with the pointer or drifts slowly, around a calm, plain body.
templates.useFor: Premium or celebratory regions: a membership or entitlement Form, a rewards Cards region, a year-in-review Chart or a Static Content announcement; also a single featured Classic Report.

templates.name: AMC Insight Frame
templates.description: A region frame that reads the report it wraps and states what the numbers say: an insight strip under the title with the total or average, row count, largest and smallest row and a share-of-total bar, plus a thin share bar under every row; no design system frame understands its content this way.
templates.useFor: Classic Report and Interactive Report regions with a numeric column (amounts, quantities, hours, percentages). Around a Form, Chart, Cards or Static Content without a table it is a plain frame.

templates.name: AMC Journey Trail
templates.description: A destinations list that remembers the user's path through the app in this tab and shows Continue where you left off as a trail of the recent pages with relative times, the page to resume highlighted and the current page marked, while destinations already visited get a quiet check.
templates.useFor: Home pages and hubs that users return to between tasks, and Page 0 as a slim recently-visited strip: order entry, case handling, approvals, any app where people jump between records and lists.

templates.name: AMC Kinetic Title
templates.description: A magazine-style region: an oversized outlined title that fills with color in a wipe on hover or keyboard focus, a small eyebrow from the icon, a thin rule that grows an accent, and the native content on a plain sheet below.
templates.useFor: Section openers on dashboards and report pages: a Chart, a Cards region of KPIs, a Classic Report or a Static Content summary that starts a new topic. Use it for a few regions per page; the title is meant to be short.

templates.name: AMC Liquid Tabs
templates.description: Tab navigation whose indicator behaves like a drop of liquid: it stretches toward the hovered or focused tab through an SVG goo filter and snaps back to the current page, instead of the flat underline of classic tabs.
templates.useFor: Page-level or section tabs on a List region: switching between sibling pages such as Dashboard, Orders, Invoices and Reports, or the tabs of a record page. One level; sub entries are ignored.

templates.name: AMC Marquee Links
templates.description: An announcement ticker: the list's links glide past in a seamless loop with faded edges and a live pulse, and pause on hover, keyboard focus or the pause button.
templates.useFor: A single strip of announcements, quick links or partner and supplier links at the top of a home page, portal or dashboard; 4 to 12 short entries.

templates.name: AMC Mega Menu
templates.description: A floating top menu bar whose parent entries swing open a glass mega panel on a perspective hinge, with a feature card for the parent page and a grid of sub pages with 3D icon tiles and descriptions.
templates.useFor: Top navigation lists with one level of sub entries: Sales with Orders, Invoices and Customers, Inventory with Stock, Warehouses and Transfers, Reports and Admin as plain links. Place the List region in the Before Navigation Bar, Breadcrumb Bar or top of Body.

templates.name: AMC Metro Steps
templates.description: Wizard progress drawn as a transit line: completed stations are ticked on a solid colored line, the current station is a large pulsing stop with a station sign, and stations still to come sit on a dashed planned line.
templates.useFor: Wizard progress lists and process steps: order checkout, employee onboarding, approval chains, goods receipt, month-end close. Best with 3 to 8 entries.

templates.name: AMC Moment Launcher
templates.description: A launcher that knows what time it is in the business: entries tagged with moments such as monthend, quarterend or friday+afternoon rise into a Right now panel when the user's local date and time match, with the reason and the working days left, and every other entry says when it comes up next.
templates.useFor: Home pages and workspace launchers of finance, HR and operations apps, where tasks follow the calendar: morning checks, Friday timesheets, month-end close, quarter-end VAT, year-end inventory.

templates.name: AMC Orbit Launcher
templates.description: An app launcher where the first list entry is a glowing hub and the other entries orbit it on a slowly turning ring with a travelling comet, instead of a flat grid of tiles.
templates.useFor: Home page and launchpad lists with 4 to 12 entries: module shortcuts, quick actions, a workspace hub.

templates.name: AMC Peek Nav
templates.description: Navigation that lets people see before they go: resting the mouse on an entry, or pressing its eye button, floats a card with a live, scaled-down, non-interactive view of the target page, so users stop opening pages just to check whether they are the right ones.
templates.useFor: Side navigation and page lists of 3 to 15 entries whose targets are read-mostly pages in the same app: Orders, Quotes, Customers, Invoices, Inventory. Not for pages that change data when they load.

templateOptions.name: Preview on click of the eye button only

templates.name: AMC Quest List
templates.description: An onboarding checklist that notices what the new user has already done: each task completes itself once its page has been opened, or by a tick, with a progress ring, points, the next task highlighted and a short celebration when everything is done.
templates.useFor: Getting-started regions on the home page of a new or newly rolled-out app, training environments, and role checklists such as first week in finance: open Orders, create an invoice, submit a timesheet, approve a request.

templates.name: AMC Segmented Glass
templates.description: A frosted-glass segmented control for page navigation: a recessed glass tray with a raised glass thumb that sits on the current page and glides to the segment under the pointer or keyboard focus, driven by CSS :has() alone.
templates.useFor: Two to eight sibling pages or views on a List region: switching a page between Board, List and Calendar views, or between Orders, Invoices and Customers. One level; sub entries are ignored.

templates.name: AMC Side Rail
templates.description: An editorial region: under a heavy top rule the title runs vertically in a side rail with the icon and header buttons stacked in it, and the native content takes the rest; in narrow containers it switches to a normal top header by itself.
templates.useFor: Sections of a report-style page or a magazine-like dashboard: a Classic Report or Interactive Report of a topic, a Chart with commentary, a Static Content article, Cards of highlights. Works well in wide body columns and still fits a narrow side column.

templates.name: AMC Smart Nav Bar
templates.description: A calm, compact pill cluster for the application Navigation Bar that knows what each entry is for: a search button that opens a command palette over the page's navigation menu, a notification bell with a remembered unread state and a feed dropdown, a help menu and an initials avatar with a user menu, and it folds extra entries into that menu by itself when the header runs out of room.
templates.useFor: The application Navigation Bar slot, User Interface > Navigation Bar > List Template, with the Navigation Bar list: Search, Notifications with one sub entry per notification from a dynamic list, Help as a link or with sub entries, and the user entry, usually &APP_USER., with Profile, Language, Preferences and Sign out as sub entries. It also works in a List region placed in the header.

attributes.a01: Role - search, notifications, help, user - or the notification key on sub entries
attributes.a02: Badge count, or read on a notification sub entry

templates.name: AMC Speed Dial
templates.description: A floating action button that springs the list entries out as mini buttons in a stack or a quarter arc, with labels sliding out beside them, instead of a static button bar.
templates.useFor: Quick action lists of 2 to 10 entries: create shortcuts on a dashboard, record actions on a detail page, a page-wide create menu on page 0 with Float on page.

templates.name: AMC Spotlight Frame
templates.description: A region frame where a pointer spotlight and a glowing border follow the mouse, and a faint grid lights up under the beam in the header only.
templates.useFor: Dashboard regions a user works in: a Classic or Interactive Report, a Chart, a Form or a KPI Cards region on a landing page.

templates.name: AMC Spotlight Grid
templates.description: A tile grid lit by one pointer spotlight that travels across all tiles at once, revealing a dot pattern and making nearby tile edges glow, while the current tile keeps a soft resting glow.
templates.useFor: Launchpads, module menus and settings hubs with 3 to 16 entries that each deserve a short description.

templates.name: AMC Stacked Deck
templates.description: List entries rest as a deck of cards stacked in perspective, each one peeking out behind the one in front, and fan out into a readable list while the deck has hover or keyboard focus.
templates.useFor: Short lists of 3 to 8 entries on dashboards and home pages: pending approvals, recent orders, inbox shortcuts, quick actions next to a chart.

templates.name: AMC Stacked Sheets
templates.description: The region is the top sheet of a small pile of offset, palette-tinted paper sheets held by a strip of tape; the sheets fan out further on hover or keyboard focus.
templates.useFor: Regions that feel like documents or drafts: a Form for a proposal or claim, a Classic Report of recent documents, a Static Content brief or note, Cards of attachments. Works best as one or two accents per page.

templates.name: AMC Terminal Window
templates.description: A desktop terminal window: an inverse-colored bezel and title bar with three window dots and the title centered in monospace after a prompt, around a readable content pane.
templates.useFor: Technical and operational regions: job logs and scheduler runs in a Classic Report, integration status Cards, an API settings Form, a code or SQL snippet in Static Content, or a Chart of error rates.

templates.name: AMC Ticket Stub
templates.description: The region is a ticket: a tinted stub with icon, title, buttons and a barcode is torn off from the body by a perforated line with punched notches, and the stub moves from the side to the top when the region gets narrow.
templates.useFor: Record-centric regions: a booking, voucher, shipment or approval Form, a Classic Report of one order's lines, a Cards region of passes, or a Chart for one event.

templates.name: AMC Zoom Dial
templates.description: A region with its own size dial: each user picks Compact, Cozy, Comfortable or Large for this one region and the native content inside is re-laid out at that size and remembered, instead of one fixed density for everybody or a browser zoom that scales the whole page.
templates.useFor: Dense Interactive Reports and Interactive Grids that power users want smaller, Forms and Classic Reports that users on large screens or with low vision want larger, Charts on wall displays, and Cards regions.
